title: Fotoğraftaki eksik

characters.DAD: a father in his forties with short dark hair, wearing a white linen shirt
characters.CHILD: a little girl of about six with a dark ponytail, wearing a red swimsuit
characters.MOM: a mother in her forties with long dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a sunflower yellow dress
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with a dark ponytail, wearing a green cardigan
characters.OLDMOM: the same mother, now in her sixties with grey hair in a ponytail, wearing a sunflower yellow cardigan

scenes.text:
Aile fotoğraflarına bak;
annen neden hep eksik?
scenes.prompt: A wooden shelf in a cozy living room with several framed family photos, warm lamp light, autumn leaves falling outside the window. No people in the room.

scenes.text:
Denizde, bayramda, doğum günlerinde;
herkes var, o yok.
scenes.prompt: On a beach at sunset, {DAD} and {CHILD} kneel side by side building a sandcastle and smiling toward the viewer, gentle waves, golden sky.

scenes.text:
Çünkü fotoğrafı hep o çekiyordu,
hepinizi kareye sığdırmak için.
scenes.prompt: On the beach at sunset, {MOM} stands alone seen from the side, holding an old camera up to her eye, smiling, gentle waves and a golden sky behind her.

scenes.text:
Onun çektiği binlerce anın var;
onunla çekilen ise çok az.
scenes.prompt: At night by a rainy window, {WOMAN} sits on the floor under a warm lamp with a large open photo album on her lap, looking at it with a soft, thoughtful smile.

scenes.text:
Bu hafta onun fotoğrafını sen çek.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: In an autumn garden at sunset, {OLDMOM} sits on a bench under a tree laughing shyly, while {WOMAN} stands a few steps away on the right smiling at her, an old camera hanging on a strap around her neck, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Annen nerede?

O hep kareyi çeken taraftaydı. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
